text:
Hi Friends,

like many others before me, I have decided to join the RTM and open a journal HERE.

I don't trade DEMO acc but a LIVE microaccount (IBFX Australia). In the
last couple of months I managed to increase my capital by 40%, for me
this is a huge success, considering counless burned DEMO accounts and
one LIVE account (USD 130 ).

I am trying to apply the concepts IF teaches but also Doctor's amazing
wisdom that he freely shares with us has helped me incredibly.

First, let me show you the summary of my trading, as you can see, my PL
Curve is a bit bumpy but the general direction is UP. For this I want to
 THANK all the great traders who share their hard earned knowledge with
us. THANK YOU GUYS AND GOD BLESS YOU ALL!

Les_Paul
